figure.panelLabels: lowercase bold upright a, b, c ... 8 pt
notes: 标准图宽：单栏 89 mm，双栏 183 mm；整页最大深度 247 mm；必要时可用一栏半（120-136 mm）。
图内文字必须是无衬线体（Arial 或 Helvetica），最小 5 pt、最大 7 pt；分图标签用 8 pt 粗体、正体（非斜体）小写 a、b、c。
图内文字须保持可编辑：不要转曲（do not outline text），嵌入 TrueType 2 或 42 字体；Matplotlib 需设 rcParams['pdf.fonttype']=42。
照片类图像最低 300 dpi；在线校样分辨率上限 450 dpi；不要把线条图或文字栅格化。
务必用可编辑矢量格式（.pdf 或 .eps 优先，也接受 .ai）；配色用 RGB（印刷时会自动转 CMYK）。
线条/组合图的 dpi 与线宽：官网规格页未给出规定值，故 rasterDpi.line、rasterDpi.combination 与 lineWidthPt 记为 null（未规定，而非未知）。
每条图注不超过 300 words，误差棒与统计检验方法必须在图注中定义。

text.abstractStyle: single 'summary paragraph', fully referenced, no headings; ideally <=200 words; 2-3 sentences of introduction, background and rationale, 'Here we show' conclusion, then 2-3 sentences of context; avoid numbers, abbreviations, acronyms and measurements unless essential
text.wordLimitNote: Article: ~2,500 words of text with 4 modest display items (6 pages), or ~4,300 words with 5-6 modest display items (8 pages); Methods typically <=3,000 words and contains no figures or tables; <=50 main-text references; title, author list, acknowledgements and references are excluded from word counts.

references.inTextExample: as previously reported13 (superscript number, no brackets unless the number could be confused with a superscript)
references.entryExample: 1. Author, A. B., Author, C. D. & Author, E. F. Title of the paper. Nature 123, 456-460 (2020).

checklist: Summary paragraph <=200 words, fully referenced, no headings, structured with 'Here we show'.
Main text <=50 references; references numbered in citation order, superscript in text.
Figures sized 89 mm (single) or 183 mm (double), page depth <=247 mm, centred on the page.
Supply figures as editable vector .pdf/.eps with text as real text (not outlined), fonts embedded (TrueType 2 or 42).
Photographic images >=300 dpi, RGB colour space; keep scale bars and labels on a separate editable layer.
Figure legends listed one after the other in the text document, after the main reference list, each <300 words.
Methods section placed in the main text file after the figure legends, with data and code availability statements.

Organize contributions in Nature's required order: title, authors, affiliations, bold first paragraph, main text, main references, tables, figure legends, methods, acknowledgements, funding, author contributions, competing interests, additional information.
commonRejectionReasons: Conclusion not of interest to an interdisciplinary readership.
Results not judged novel and arresting (illuminating, unexpected or surprising).
Work lacks both immediate and far-reaching implications.
Referees raised considerable technical objections and/or the authors' claim was not adequately established.
Extremely selective: only about 8% of submitted manuscripts are accepted, and most submissions are declined without being sent for peer review.
